status: Local operator/case integration verified; shipped flags disabled; hosted acceptance and release open.
technical_decisions: Public content publication requires the same authorized human to review and explicitly confirm; no two-person publication approval requirement was invented.
Payment-case approve/reject requires a separate authorized checker, enforced at SQL INSERT; two roles on one subject do not permit self-review.
No financial tables, confirmed payments, allocations, refund execution, entitlement activation, SMS collection or provider commands are introduced.
Only runtime ctx.access supplies human account/audience/UUID identity; private service bindings and same-origin intent/CSRF remain exact and fail closed.
All shipped API/UI/case/metrics switches remain false; case storage stays a new isolated placeholder database and enrollment generator produces disabled rows only.
Both clients compile with existing TypeScript and invoke Window fetch without a client receiver. Post-commit 401/403 cannot prove no publication occurred.
Identity change/revocation clears old private display; original actor/club recovery records, immutable outcomes and exact keys survive unknown acknowledgements.
Controlled browser fixture uses unusable JSON after one real commit, avoiding Chromium internal retransmission of a pre-header reset; reload/recovery assert zero application POSTs.

actual_browser.scope: Actual installed Chromium, active gateway/UI and local SQLite with synthetic Access/RPC/R2; no hosted Cloudflare acceptance
